text:
maya: CI failure on master: audit-event-validator tests failing after my RBAC schema tweak. Golden mismatch on customer_read events. cc @sam @kevin

sam: Link to CI: https://ci.redwood/internal/4567 — failing job 789

audit-bot: Job failed: audit-validator-e2e #789
Error: mismatched fields in golden fixture diff
Path: events.customer_read.actor.roles

kevin: Can you paste the diff? quick guess: roles renamed to role_ids?

maya: Paste below:
```json
{"event_type":"customer_read","actor":{"id":"user:123","roles":["admin"]},"resource":{"id":"cust:567"}}
```
Golden expects `actor.roles` to be object with `role_ids`.

jen: Wait — RBAC change in PR #1147 renamed roles -> role_ids earlier. Did we forget a migration for audit pipeline?

sam: Looks like validator schema still v1.2; RBAC change bumped model to v1.3. The schema version header in event is 'audit_schema_version': 'v1.2' or missing?

maya: The incoming events (from staging) don't include schema version. Example event above is from staging ingest. Validator loads golden fixtures that include v1.3 shape. So CI comparing staging events to golden fails.

alex: Two paths: (A) update validator to accept both shapes (backcompat shim), (B) ensure event generator includes schema header, or (C) re-run golden fixtures to match new shape. Which is correct for production?

kevin: We should not silently accept both shapes for long. For customer-facing audit events, we need explicit versioning header. Short-term: add migration step in validator that maps role_ids <-> roles for CI so tests pass. Long-term: require schema version in envelope.

maya: I'll open a small PR for shim in validator + add logging when shim applied. Also will add a note in RBAC PR to include schema header. Assigning to @sam to coordinate.

sam: @maya assign me please. Also we should add unit to ensure golden fixture generation pipeline stamps schema_version. I'll add to backlog.

jen: FYI: KMS rotation task might affect signing of audit envelope; confirm we didn't break signing when we touched RBAC. Quick check: do we validate signature in validator? audit-validator has `validate_signature` flag default true in CI.

maya: Good catch. Validator logs show signature ok. Here's failing excerpt:
```
diff --golden new
- \"actor\": {\"role_ids\": [\"r-1\"]}
+ \"actor\": {\"roles\": [\"admin\"]}
```
No signature errors.

audit-bot: Note: Golden fixtures updated 2025-11-02 by jen. Commit 58ab3c.

kevin: Plan: maya PR for shim + unit, sam update golden generator to include schema header, jen follow up on KMS signing audit. Target: patch CI fix today, full spec update in next sprint.

maya: Creating PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/audit-validator/pull/202 — includes shim and extra log. Will link to this thread.

sam: :+1:
